name: penname-ios
description: Penname for iOS and Android — native shell (Capacitor) around the Penname Mobile web app

scripts.sync: rsync -a ../ios/index.html ../ios/style.css ../ios/app.js ../ios/gazetteer.js ../ios/engine.js ../ios/activity.js ../ios/sw.js ../ios/manifest.webmanifest www/ && rsync -a --delete ../ios/icons/ www/icons/ && rsync -a --delete ../ios/fonts/ www/fonts/ && rsync -a www/ ios/App/App/public/ && mkdir -p android/app/src/main/assets/public && rsync -a www/ android/app/src/main/assets/public/ && echo 'www and the iOS and Android bundles synced from ../ios'
